title: Segmented icon groups draw 36px and keep a 44px tap area
context: Decision 0121 drew every button at its real 44px touch size. Rows of segmented icon choices, such as the stats set switcher and the lineup switcher, then filled most of a card header and made the page feel crowded. HIG asks for a hit region of at least 44x44 pt, not a 44pt visual size, and the `.touch-target` utility already grows a tap area without changing the drawn size.
decision: Button sizes are `default`, `lg` and `icon` only, each 44px tall under `pointer: coarse` and 36, 40 and 36x36 under `pointer: fine`; `sm`, `xs` and `wide` stay removed. Size follows role: a page's primary action and every `type="submit"` use `lg`, an in-section action and AlertDialog actions use `default`, and side-by-side buttons share one size with the variant showing importance. Floating header, back and close controls alone use the outline-free, circular Liquid Glass `glass` variant (translucent fill, blur, inner highlight; opaque under reduced transparency or more contrast), with RiArrowLeftSLine and RiCloseLine as their only glyphs. Single-select, immediately applied choices use the `segmented` variant, whose selected state follows `aria-pressed` or radio checked. A `segmented` button at `icon` size is drawn 36x36 under every pointer and uses `.touch-target`, so its tap area stays `--control-size` on touch; callers do not opt in. Every other button keeps its real size. The navigation FAB and the landing CTAButton keep their own sizes.

alternatives.option: Add a compact `icon` size that callers choose
alternatives.reason: It reopens the per-page size choice that removing `sm` closed; tying the size to `segmented` keeps it to groups by definition.
Siblings would need a 12px gap to keep tap areas apart and pointer: fine would need its own size; 36px matches the fine-pointer size and the existing 8px gap.

alternatives.option: Shrink the `.touch-target` area where neighbours overlap
alternatives.reason: It drops the tap area below 44px, the one requirement HIG sets.

alternatives.option: Keep every button at its real 44px size
alternatives.reason: Dense segmented rows crowd card headers for no gain in tap area.

consequences: The stats set switcher and the lineup switcher draw 36px on touch without caller changes.
Siblings of a segmented icon need a gap of at least 8px (`--control-size` minus 36px) so tap areas do not intersect, and no ancestor may clip the 4px the tap area extends.
A lone segmented icon would also draw 36px; segmented means a choice among siblings, so that case should not arise.
Decision 0121 is superseded; its still-valid rules are restated here.
revisitTriggers: A dense control other than a segmented icon group needs a visual size below its tap area.
A role appears that neither `default` nor `lg` fits.
